# 📂 scripts

[![Open api-reference-report.py](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open-api--reference--report.py-blue)](api-reference-report.py)

Contains helper scripts invoked by CI workflows.

Use the log wrapper when a CI command needs an artifact and an exit status. The consumer script builds a separate release executable that imports both products.
